selected_evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker installed as managed service 'inventory-worker' under dedicated 'inventorysvc' account
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed binary exists, created inventorysvc system user, wrote systemd unit with User=inventorysvc, enabled+started the service, and verified via ps that the running process (PID 2920) is owned by inventorysvc.
Captured pre-restart boot_id (8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594) as the stable boot marker, with prior command confirming service was active.
Issued 'sudo systemctl reboot' backgrounded so the exec call returned an acknowledgement before disconnect; subsequent command showed connection refused, proving the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Polled until node1 became reachable again; boot_id read as 39510b7f-5faf-498a-a522-628f41f3f943, differing from the pre-restart value, and uptime -s showed a new boot time (09:15:00 vs 09:14:07).

After restart, inventory-worker.service reported active/enabled and the running process (new PID 837) was confirmed via ps to be owned by inventorysvc, showing the service auto-started under the correct account after reboot.
